speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing swelling in your right knee and have a family history of similar issues; to begin our evaluation, how old are you and exactly how long has this swelling been present? Additionally, does the knee experience pain, stiffness, or locking movements, and did the symptoms start suddenly or develop gradually?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: NOT YET DETERMINED; PLEASE ANSWER THE FOLLOWING QUESTIONS:

1. How old is the child?
2. Did you notice any bruising or swelling in other joints of his body?
3. Does the swelling improve when he elevates his leg?
4. Have you noticed any limping or difficulty walking since the swelling started?
5. Is there any history of bleeding after minor bumps or falls in the past?
6. Are his gums swollen or does he bleed easily when brushing his teeth?
7. Does he have any easy bruising on his arms or legs?
8. Has he had any recent infections or fevers?
9. Does the swelling occur on the left knee or other joints as well?
10. Do you have any other family members with joint problems or bleeding disorders?
